optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Trade Finance Operations Specialist, Documentary Credits

professionalSummary.text: Four years of experience as a Trade Finance Operations Specialist at a commercial bank, examining 600+ documentary credit presentations annually against bank examination standards.
professionalSummary.witness: Trade finance operations specialist at a commercial bank for four years, examining presented documents against documentary credit terms under the bank's examination standard for about six hundred presentations a year.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared discrepancy notices and payment instructions for checker's release, with release authority retained by checkers under four-eyes rule, documented in trade system.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the discrepancy notices and the payment instructions for each presentation for the checker's release; the release was the checker's under the four-eyes rule, recorded against my preparation in the trade system.

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded checkers' decisions in trade system and maintained current client status reports for relationship managers daily.
experienceHighlights.witness: Recorded the checkers' decisions in the trade system and kept the client status report current for the relationship managers each day.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated document queries with correspondent banks via query log, documenting closed queries and referrals to checkers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated document queries with the correspondent banks' trade desks through the query log, recording which queries I closed and which were referred to the checker.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented transaction open items and hand-over conditions daily for next examiner.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions for each transaction at day end for the next examiner.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Anonymized presentation file with examination worksheet, discrepancy notice, payment instruction, and checker's release record, plus client status report with trade system audit history as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one anonymised presentation file (examination worksheet, discrepancy notice, payment instruction with the checker's release record) and one client status report, with the trade system's audit history as a verification trail.

skills.text: Documentary credit examination, discrepancy resolution, trade system documentation, client status reporting, query coordination with correspondent banks.
skills.witness: Trade finance operations specialist at a commercial bank for four years, examining presented documents against documentary credit terms under the bank's examination standard for about six hundred presentations a year. Prepared the discrepancy notices and the payment instructions for each presentation for the checker's release; the release was the checker's under the four-eyes rule, recorded against my preparation in the trade system. Recorded the checkers' decisions in the trade system and kept the client status report current for the relationship managers each day. Coordinated document queries with the correspondent banks' trade desks through the query log, recording which queries I closed and which were referred to the checker. Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions for each transaction at day end for the next examiner.
